notes.title: Winter Update!
notes.content:
New Plane: Sakura!
Its guns may not have the longest range, but this plane excels at ramming enemies. Banzai!

New Air Combat Maps!
Take to the skies in new and exciting battle maps.

Random!
Now you can use random planes, spawn points and maps.

Improved Interface!
Enjoy a smoother and more intuitive user experience.

Bug Fixes!
We’ve addressed several issues to enhance gameplay stability and performance.

Update your game and dominate the skies!
